thesis: GMAB is a profitable, cash-generative company in a confirmed uptrend (close above SMA20, SMA50 and SMA200) that is digesting a large October re-rating. It is rebounding out of a six-week base and sits about 5% below its 52-week high, with sell-side support (RBC, mean target above price) and no earnings event inside the swing window. The entry zone is a modest dip rather than a chase, and the trade pays only on a breakout through 59.97 toward 64.4. The setup is only moderate: reward/risk is 1.55, the last leg had weak volume, and the regime is risk-off. This supports a small, disciplined long, not a high-conviction one.
